snippet.title: The Grand Slamboree - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4130860/The_Grand_Slamboree/

The greatest collection of fighters in the universe... weren't available. 
The Grand Slamboree is a chaotic platform-fighter, where every hit is lethal! Play locally, via Steam Remote Play or against bots, and become champion of The Grand Slamboree. 


The Grand Slamboree releases later this year!



A Game by Alex Jackson
